title: CareLine Service Plans Visit Rate Card — Trip Fees, Labor and Scheduling
content:
Rates for repair and glass visits on the CareLine Service Plans family. The trip fee is charged once per repair or glass visit, however many openings are worked on during that visit, on every tier.

### Trip fees and free trips

| Tier | Trip fee per repair or glass visit (USD) | Repair or glass visits per plan year with the trip fee waived | One trip fee covers every opening worked on in one visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 129.00 | 0 | Yes |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 89.00 | 0 | Yes |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 69.00 | 0 | Yes |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 69.00 | 4 | Yes |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 69.00 | 4 | Yes |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 49.00 | 6 | Yes |

### Labor

| Tier | Hourly labor rate for repair work (USD) | Minimum billable labor per repair visit | Billable labor beyond the minimum rounded up to |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 129.00 | 1.0 hour | 0.5 hour |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 119.00 | 1.0 hour | 0.5 hour |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 109.00 | 1.0 hour | 0.5 hour |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 99.00 | 1.0 hour | 0.5 hour |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 99.00 | 1.0 hour | 0.5 hour |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 99.00 | 1.0 hour | 0.5 hour |

### Scheduling

| Tier | Business days after a repair request within which a visit is offered | Technician arrival window |
|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 10 | 4 hours |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 7 | 4 hours |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 5 | 4 hours |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 3 | 4 hours |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 3 | 4 hours |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 3 | 4 hours |

### Billable hours on this card, hypothetical times on site

With the minimum of 1.0 hour and the 0.5-hour increment that every tier uses:

| Hypothetical hours on site | Billable hours |
|---|---|
| 0.4 | 1.0 (the minimum) |
| 1.0 | 1.0 |
| 1.1 | 1.5 |
| 1.5 | 1.5 |
| 1.6 | 2.0 |

A hypothetical CareLine Plus Plan visit with 1.6 hours on site therefore bills 2.0 hours at 109.00 per hour, a labor amount of 218.00.

### Points of reading

**Does a visit at which three openings are repaired carry three trip fees?** No. One trip fee covers every opening worked on during one visit.

**Is a free trip a free visit?** A free trip waives the trip fee only; labor on that visit is still billed at the tier's hourly rate for the billable hours.
